"use client"

import type { ReactNode } from "react"
import { adminRegistries, requireRegistryEntry } from "@/admin/registries"
import { AdminDataTable, type AdminColumnDefinition, type AdminDataTableState } from "@/components/admin/data-table"

export type DataGridColumn = AdminColumnDefinition & { cell?: string }

export function DataGrid({ rows, columns, loading = false, error = null, onRetry = () => {}, rowCount, state, onStateChange, renderRowActions }: {
  rows: readonly Record<string, unknown>[]
  columns: readonly DataGridColumn[]
  loading?: boolean
  error?: Error | null
  onRetry?: () => void
  rowCount?: number
  state?: AdminDataTableState
  onStateChange?: (state: AdminDataTableState) => void
  renderRowActions?: (row: Record<string, unknown>) => ReactNode
}) {
  const resolvedColumns = columns.map(({ cell, ...column }) => ({ ...column, render: cell ? requireRegistryEntry<NonNullable<AdminColumnDefinition["render"]>>("cell", adminRegistries.cells, cell) : undefined }))
  return <AdminDataTable data={rows} columns={resolvedColumns} loading={loading} error={error} onRetry={onRetry} mode={state ? "server" : "client"} rowCount={rowCount} state={state} onStateChange={onStateChange} renderRowActions={renderRowActions} />
}

// Existing generated routes may continue importing AdminDataTable while new routes use DataGrid.
